1.consolidated_definition: Ponerse la gallina clueca sobre los huevos para empollarlos, calentándolos durante 21 días. Mientras transcurre este período se dice que la gallina está echada.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To sit the broody hen on top of her eggs to incubate them, warming them for 21 days. During this period, it is said that the hen is set.
